name: Molecule Caption Arena
description: A comprehensive benchmark for evaluating LLM-augmented molecular property prediction, assessing the ability of language models to enhance molecular representations across diverse prediction tasks using a novel battle-based rating system.
reputation: A recent domain-specific benchmark that is emerging in molecular ML, but it is not yet widely established as a standard community leaderboard.
notes: Includes evaluation of over twenty LLMs and introduces a novel battle-based rating system for molecule captioners.
